dr-zhou.name: Dr. Wei Zhou, LAc
dr-zhou.title: Acupuncturist
dr-zhou.description: Dr. Zhou holds a PhD in Traditional Chinese Medicine and is a licensed acupuncturist specialized in traditional Chinese medicine with extensive acupuncture and herbal experience over 45 years.
dr-zhou.summary: Dr. Zhou holds a PhD in Traditional Chinese Medicine and has been receiving formal TCM professional education in China university of TCM since 1978. He has practiced Traditional Chinese Medicine in Chinese medical institutions for more than 40+ years. He has a senior professional title and is a member of the Chinese Association of Chinese Medicine.
credentials: Master's Degree in Oriental Medicine - FCIM (USA)
